# Working of Shell Sort

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Working of Shell Sort

After interval-based sorting, our vector now has the smaller elements far closer to the start than at the end.

Only 1, 5, and 8 are out of place and need to be shifted by only one place each.

![Sort the Subvector](data:image/png;base64,)

So if we now perform insertion sort like we did previously (in chapter 2), it requires far less shifting than it would have previously needed.

This means we will now be sorting with an interval 1 (i.e. the entire vector).

![Sort the Vector Using Insertion Sort](data:image/png;base64,)

This vector is now fully sorted.
